items.name: Reed Crown Circlet
items.lore: A circlet of woven reeds. The bogmen made it for a king.

items.name: Bog-King's Ring
items.lore: Bone and black amber. Too large for a man's hand; it fits anyway.

items.name: Lily-Pad Mantle
items.lore: Green and slick and strangely warm. The bogmen are better weavers than they look.

items.name: Marsh-Warden's Belt
items.lore: Brec's spare. It has a pocket for everything.

items.name: Signet of the Vigil
items.lore: The ring of a drowned order of knights. Their oath is engraved inside: 'Until relieved.'

items.name: Banner of the Vigil
items.lore: The order's banner, cut down to a cloak. It is still wet, months later.

items.name: Corentin's Sword-Belt
items.lore: A good knight's belt, worn smooth where the sword rode.

items.name: Relief-Bell Charm
items.lore: A tiny bronze bell, the kind that rang the changing of the watch.

items.name: Bog-Net Bracer
items.lore: Cut from a bogman's net. It still smells of fish.

items.name: Retreat Warden's Belt
items.lore: Marsh Warden issue, waxed against the damp.

items.name: Bloody-Bones Knuckle Charm
items.lore: Don't ask whose knuckle.

items.name: Drowned Bell-Rope Belt
items.lore: From the bell of a church the marsh swallowed.

items.name: Wisp-Glass Ring
items.lore: A trapped wisp-light, very faint, inside a glass bead.

items.name: Reed-Cutter's Sash
items.lore: Woven from marsh reeds by Warden Brec's wife.

items.name: Scrag-Hide Bracer
items.lore: Tough, warty and surprisingly comfortable.

items.name: Scraek's Tooth Charm
items.lore: Scraek had a lot of teeth. Now he has one fewer.

items.name: Mist-Sprite Veil
items.lore: So fine you can see through it. The mist sticks to it.

items.name: Isle-Shore Pebble Ring
items.lore: A white pebble from the Isle's shore, set in silver.

items.name: Barge-Oar Bracer
items.lore: Black wood, salt-white at the grip.

items.name: Chapel-Register Clasp
items.lore: From the chapel's register of the dead. Argante kept the book.

items.name: Page's Black Ribbon
items.lore: The pages of the shore chapel wore black for the King.

items.name: Fiedel's Tarnished Spur
items.lore: Silver gone black. He was a good knight, once.

items.name: Aryon's Broken Oath-Ring
items.lore: Snapped clean in two, and mended with gold.

items.name: Shore-Vigil Mantle
items.lore: Black, with the Isle's white tower. The Keepers' own.

items.name: Shambler-Moss Bracer
items.lore: Thick green moss on leather. It never dries out.

items.name: Granite-Dust Charm
items.lore: Pink-grey dust in a glass vial. Dartmoor granite.

items.name: Giant-Wolf Pelt Mantle
items.lore: Grey and huge. It drags on the ground even after Brec's wife cut it down.

items.name: Wolf-Fang Torc
items.lore: Three fangs, each as long as a finger.

items.name: Mist-Monster Eye
items.lore: A pale, clouded orb. It looks back.

items.name: Fog-Walker's Belt
items.lore: Hung with bells so your friends can find you in the fog.

items.name: Causeway Kerb-Stone Ring
items.lore: Cut from the giants' kerb-stone. Heavy.

items.name: Marsh-Warden's Wading Mantle
items.lore: Oiled wool to the knee. The wardens swear by it.

items.name: Brec's Lucky Charm
items.lore: Brec's own, a pierced shell. He says he won't need luck now.

items.name: Marsh Lord's Sceptre-Ring
items.lore: A ring of black bog-oak, from his reed sceptre.

items.name: Mire-Crown Torc
items.lore: Twisted bog-iron. He wore it as a crown.

items.name: Peat-Black Mantle
items.lore: Smells of peat smoke, always.

items.name: Ghoul-Court Seal
items.lore: The seal of the Vigil's court, gone green.

items.name: Footman's Rusted Bracer
items.lore: Rusted through in places. Still turns a blade.

items.name: Vigil-Tower Ring
items.lore: The Vigil's white tower, cut in grey stone.

items.name: Drowned Keep Torc
items.lore: Green bronze, from the keep's chapel.

items.name: Relief-Watch Mantle
items.lore: Grey wool. Worn by those who came to relieve the Vigil.

items.name: Argante's Pearl
items.lore: A pearl from the Isle's shore. It glows at dusk.

items.name: Orkney Queen's Circlet-Ring
items.lore: Cut from Morgause's circlet. It's colder than metal should be.

items.name: Keeper of the Isle's Mantle
items.lore: White and grey, with the Isle's tower. Argante's gift.

items.name: Sleeper's Guard Torc
items.lore: Given to those who stood between the King and his enemies.
